feature.title: マッチメイキングの参加・状態取得・継続・キャンセル
flow: Browser current/ticket/join/heartbeat/cancel handlers authenticate the cookie and derive the owner before issuing the corresponding GameService RPC.

GameRpc validates typed owner, UUID, pool and heartbeat values, then delegates JoinMatchmaking, GetMatchmaking, GetMatchmakingTicket, HeartbeatMatchmaking and CancelMatchmaking to the durable repository.
PostgreSQL transactions serialize admission, expire stale waiting state and preserve historical tickets, refusals and cancellation tombstones; pairing is traced separately.

guarantees.statement: An owner may request either supported rated pool, with at most one waiting or playing participation across pools. The server captures the admission rating and preserves the UUID retry identity.
Current participation and historical ticket reads are owner-scoped. Exact retries retain stored outcomes; a different pool conflicts. Refusals and cancellation before join remain durable.

Waiting lasts 30 seconds from admission or the latest strictly newer positive heartbeat. Duplicate/older heartbeats do not extend or revive it. Cancellation ends waiting but cannot cancel an already matched game.

The five browser matchmaking operations require a valid session, enforce Host and mutation Origin/same-site checks, reject caller user_id, return stable ticket/error JSON and apply no-store. OpenAPI describes all five operations.

contracts.statement: The transaction checks existing owner/UUID first, then global active participation and per-pool pending rating reservations; admitted/refused state is committed for later retries.

source.needle: async fn join(&self, user: UserId, id: TicketId, pool: Pool) -> Result<JoinOutcome, MError> {

evidence.reason: The stored already_waiting refusal is replayed after cancellation before reconnect. After reconnect, cancel-before-join tombstones remain Cancelled in both pools; changed-pool retries conflict.
Concurrent different-pool joins produce exactly one created admission.
After game finish the same-pool admission is rating_pending, while another pool remains available.

contracts.statement: Current and ticket operations expire stale state transactionally and query the authenticated owner; current returns only waiting/playing participation.

source.needle: async fn current(&self, user: &UserId) -> Result<Participation, MError> {

evidence.reason: Foreign owner ticket lookup returns NotFound and old cancelled identity cannot alter a newer waiting request.
After forced expiry current becomes Idle.
Browser retrieves current playing game and stored refusal by ticket identity.

contracts.statement: Only an unexpired Waiting ticket with a larger sequence gets a fresh database-time expiry; all terminal states retain their stored state.

evidence.reason: Duplicate sequence returns exactly the same ticket; a newer heartbeat after forced expiry produces Expired and does not revive admission.
HTTP rejects sequence zero and duplicate sequence one returns the same ticket.

contracts.gap: No selected assertion enumerates all older sequences, all non-Waiting states or exact wall-clock timing boundaries.

contracts.statement: Cancellation transitions a live waiting ticket or inserts an owner-scoped tombstone; matched/terminal tickets are returned without cancelling a game.

source.needle: async fn cancel(&self, user: &UserId, id: TicketId) -> Result<Ticket, MError> {

evidence.reason: Cancellation before join survives reconnect and both pool joins; cancelling an old identity leaves a newer ticket waiting.
Each race commits either cancellation with no game or two Playing tickets for one game.
Cancel of an already Playing ticket equals its prior ticket.

contracts.statement: The five matchmaking RPC methods parse owner/UUID, validate supported pool and positive heartbeat, delegate owner-scoped operations and serialize ticket states.

evidence.reason: Unknown/unspecified pool and nonpositive heartbeat are InvalidArgument, exact retry returns unchanged ticket with created=false, foreign owner is NotFound and playing/cancel responses preserve game identity.
All five RPCs are exercised through browser calls and return the asserted current, stored, heartbeat and cancellation outcomes.

contracts.gap: Malformed owner/UUID cases are not enumerated for every RPC; the dedicated TCP test does not assert a successful heartbeat. Browser tests assert successful heartbeat through RPC.

contracts.statement: Browser handlers derive owner from session authentication and check exact Host, required mutation Origin and optional same-site metadata before typed admission.

evidence.reason: Anonymous current is 401, foreign owner is 404 and wrong Origin/Host is 403.
Missing mutation Origin, duplicate cookie, unknown pool and forged user_id are rejected; no rejected admission leaves a ticket.

contracts.gap: No dedicated assertion covers every malformed UUID, DELETE body rejection, saturated HTTP permit or authentication/backend timeout branch.

contracts.statement: Ticket responses preserve server state and distinguish newly created, replayed, refused and already-matched cancellation outcomes; router middleware adds no-store.

evidence.reason: New join is 201 with no-store, replay is 200 with identical JSON, pool conflict is 409, playing cancellation is 409 already_matched with game_id.

contracts.gap: no-store is asserted for representative successes and Origin failures, not every response class; all DTO corruption and upstream error mappings lack dedicated assertions.

contracts.statement: The generated matchmaking OpenAPI includes the five owner-scoped operations and cookie authentication alternatives.

evidence.reason: All five method/path operations and both cookie schemes with alternative requirements are inspected.

tests.name: durable_retry_refusal_and_cancel_before_join_survive_reconnect
tests.scope: Real PostgreSQL with SeaOrmStore and application operations; no browser or RPC transport.

tests.name: heartbeat_retries_do_not_extend_and_expired_waiting_never_revives
tests.scope: Real PostgreSQL with SeaOrmStore and application operations; no browser or RPC transport. Database expiry is forced.

tests.name: cancellation_racing_a_match_has_one_committed_outcome
tests.scope: Real PostgreSQL with SeaOrmStore and application operations; no browser or RPC transport. Eight concurrent cancellation/matcher races.

tests.name: cross_pool_joins_and_multiple_matchers_have_one_durable_winner
tests.scope: Real PostgreSQL with SeaOrmStore and application operations; no browser or RPC transport. Concurrent admission and matcher tasks.

tests.name: pair_failure_rolls_back_and_terminal_failure_preserves_both_active_tickets
tests.scope: Real PostgreSQL with SeaOrmStore and application operations; no browser or RPC transport. Injected SQL failures and post-finish rating reservation checks.

tests.name: matchmaking_rpc_validates_requests_and_recovers_durable_owner_scoped_results
tests.scope: Generated gRPC client over TCP, GameRpc, application and real PostgreSQL; test-only game seeding is fixture setup.

tests.name: authenticated_matchmaking_recovers_requests_and_rejects_cross_site_or_foreign_access
tests.scope: Real HTTP/WebSocket gateway, user HTTP service, game gRPC service, PostgreSQL and Valkey; external OIDC provider is a fixture.

tests.name: matchmaking_checks_cookie_origin_and_input_before_admission
tests.scope: Real HTTP/WebSocket gateway, user HTTP service, game gRPC service, PostgreSQL and Valkey; external OIDC provider is a fixture.

tests.name: matchmaking_openapi_covers_all_owner_scoped_routes
tests.scope: Inspects generated OpenAPI only; no service fixture or network calls.

limitations: gRPC accepts caller identity claims and does not authenticate users; authenticated owner derivation belongs to the browser gateway.
Selected tests do not exhaust every heartbeat ordering, malformed field, no-store response class or backend failure branch.
Links and passing tests do not establish semantic completeness; changes to guarantees, evidence strength and decomposition require review.
